title: Revenue from Contracts with Customers
intro: IFRS 15 = **5 خطوات**: العقد ← التزامات الأداء ← سعر المعاملة ← التوزيع ← الاعتراف بالإيراد.
الإيراد يُعترف به لما **السيطرة** تنتقل للعميل: على مدى زمني أو عند نقطة زمنية.

tf.s: Revenue is recognised when control of goods or services passes to the customer.
Variable consideration is included only to the extent a significant reversal is highly probable not to occur.
The transaction price is allocated based on each obligation's profit margin.
tf.why: It is allocated on relative stand-alone selling prices.

tf.s: A contract liability arises when the customer pays before the entity performs.
Incremental costs of obtaining a contract are always expensed.
tf.why: They are capitalised if expected to be recovered (practical expedient for 1 year or less).
